messages:
Tom: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing section. Two things my team needs clarified: 1) exact UTC/time when dev sandbox credits reset, and 2) is there a documented playbook for short-lived CI/test exemptions (programmatic path vs manual)?

Leah (CEO): Short answers: credits reset at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month. We don't roll over by default. Exemption playbook is being formalized — high level below.

Maya (Product): Draft playbook: org-admin opt-in flag in Console -> request short-lived token (TTL) or enable per-run header -> audit & auto-expiry. Plan to ship H2. Key pieces: Console UX, token issuance API, and audit log.

Eli (Infra): Technical sketch + example header for CI runs. Prefer ephemeral tokens over global flags. Example cURL:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>" -H "X-Redwood-Test-Exempt: true" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

Tokens auto-expire and are tagged in ingress so billing/metrics can filter. We will not bypass SLO enforcement; exemptions only change quota gating and billing classification.

Sana (Finance): Finance guardrails: small test tokens (<=100k tokens/day) will be auto-approved; 100k-1M will require manager approval; >1M requires finance review. Any exemptions are logged and visible in billing exports. Enterprise SOWs can request custom buffers/rollover.

Tom: Thanks  Can we get the internal draft link and a short RFC for token shape? My infra team will validate metrics + billing events.

AlertBot: Internal doc draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing/exemptions-draft (bot message).

Maya (Product): Will open RFC this week with token schema (aud, exp, org_id, scope=exempt:test). Also adding acceptance criteria: audit events emitted, Console toggle, token TTL <= 24h by default, and CSV export for finance reconciliations.

Eli (Infra): I'll validate the metrics pipeline: ensure exempted requests still emit per-route usage and billing tags. Will create infra ticket and tag @Sana @Maya.

Sana (Finance): Also: credit reset reminder emails will go out to org owners 72h before month-end during the pilot.

Tom: Action items captured. I'll open a GH issue to track infra validation + Console flag + RFC. @Maya @Eli @Sana please add PRs/acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

Leah (CEO): Thanks all. We'll update the product board and surface pilot details to shortlisted customers next week.

Maya (Product): Ack.
